versions.changelog:
- Added homepage field to skill metadata.  
- Updated version to 1.0.1.  
- No functional changes to logic or usage.

Initial release of vcf-loginsight-health

- Provides health checks for Aria Operations for Logs (Log Insight) clusters in VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments.
- Verifies required credentials (`LOGINSIGHT_HOST`, `LOGINSIGHT_API_TOKEN`) and required tools (`curl`, `jq`).
- Fetches overall cluster health and detailed node status, including uptime.
- Reports summarized, human-readable health and node status, highlighting any errors or disconnected nodes.
